learningObjective: Distinguish ONNX IR version (format) from opset version (operator semantics).

canonicalClaims.claim: ONNX has two independent versioning axes: `ir_version` (ModelProto format/schema features) and one or more `opset_import` entries (per-domain operator semantics).
nonImplications: Does not imply the two version numbers are linked.
Does not imply supporting a high IR version implies supporting all opsets.

misconceptions.claim: IR version and opset version are the same field.
misconceptions.whyWrong: They are two separate fields with different roles.

misconceptions.claim: IR version is used only at export time and ignored by runtimes.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Runtimes must parse according to IR version.

misconceptions.claim: IR version N always corresponds to opset version N.
ONNX models are versionless; the runtime infers everything from op names.
misconceptions.whyWrong: IR + opset versions are required for correct interpretation.
